name: hdie_pc_ctrl_cfg-cfg-h6-nooverflight-west-COMMIT
purpose: H6 after H4 GRT failure33 overflow: diagnostic full-M5 SRAM no-overflight reservation removed every capacity-zero SRAM pin-face marker (33->11 overflow). Remaining11 are positive-capacity channel overloads, mainly west x2..24/y133..134. Reserve the entire M5 macro footprint via OT_MEG_DEPTH_UM=48 using the same add/remove guard and ECO propagation; widen west logic/routing corridor34.56->56.16um by moving both SRAMs+21.6um and growing outline164.16x164.16->185.76x164.16, keeping east clearance. +3545.856um2/PC (+0.113467392mm2 for32PC), +0 cycles, same actual SRAM/logic/pin faces/layer cap/clock/signoff. Retain H4 RTL because H5 one-hot eligibility reduced gates but worsened TT placement diagnostic -29.2->-60.9ps; H4 production exact/mutants remain source-identical.
